limitations: Development verification only; official evaluation has not run.
No synthesis or board verification performed.
implementation: One-bit rising-edge register captures r_in when L is asserted and q_in otherwise. Original ports are preserved; no reset, initialization, extra ports, or extra latency.
testbench: Independent directed oracle checks initial unknown output, all eight binary input combinations repeated three times, selected and unselected unknown/high-impedance data, changes between edges, and falling-edge stability. Includes fatal mismatch detection and bounded timeout.
static_review: Single sequential driver, nonblocking assignments, one-bit widths, and original cycle semantics preserved.
